name: VEOZAH
indications_original: VEOZAH® is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms due to menopause.
contraindications_original: One 45 mg tablet orally once daily with or without food. Perform baseline hepatic laboratory tests to evaluate for hepatic function and injury before beginning VEOZAH. While using VEOZAH, perform follow-up hepatic laboratory tests monthly for the first 3 months, at 6 months, and 9 months after initiation of therapy or when signs or symptoms suggest liver injury. ( 2.1 )
adverseReactions_original:
VEOZAH is contraindicated in women with any of the following conditions:
                  
                     
                        •Known cirrhosis [see Warnings and Precautions (
                        
                           5.1), Use in Specific Populations (8.7), and Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)].
                     
                        •Severe renal impairment or end-stage renal disease [see Use in Specific Populations (8.6) and Clinical Pharmacology (
                        
                           12.3)].
                     
                        •Concomitant use with CYP1A2 inhibitors [see Drug Interactions (7.1) and Clinical Pharmacology (
                        
                           12.3)].
